Name: Easier Cave Puzzle
Author: Atravita
Description:
This mod makes that one cave puzzle easier.

By default, it simply requires the player interact with the statue again before the next round plays; this allows you to take a breather between rounds. But optionally, you can slow down the patterns (by increasing the [font=Courier New]SpeedModifier[/font]) or make the flashes last longer (by increasing [font=Courier New]FlashScale[/font]). You can also cap the maximum number of notes in eacn round with [font=Courier New]MaxNotes[/font].

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download and install [AtraCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Configuration

1.  [font=Courier New]SpeedModifer[/font]: A multiplier that controls the gap between notes in the puzzle. Set higher to increase the gap between notes. **This can be set locally** (1 = same as vanilla.)

2.  [font=Courier New]FlashScale[/font]: A multiplier that controls how long the flashes of light last. Set higher for them to last longer. **This can be set locally** (1 = same as vanilla.)

3.  [font=Courier New]MaxNotes[/font]: Caps the maximum number of notes per round. (Default to 7, same as vanilla). **Host must set this - it is ignored for farmhands**.

4.  [font=Courier New]PauseBetweenRounds[/font]: If set true, the puzzle will pause between rounds - you must talk to the statue again to continue. **Host must set this - it is ignored for farmhands**. (Much thanks to [unlitday](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/114778613/) for writing the dialogue for me!)

5.  [font=Courier New]AllowReAsks[/font]: Whether or not the statue will repeat the pattern if asked to.
Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Probably best if everyone installs this mod in multipalyer.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods.
Technical note: this mod heavily relies on transpilers and may not be compatible with any other mod that edits the cave puzzle.
